doc.title: Functionality Not Available
doc.summary: This document outlines current features and functionalities that are not available or possible in the Asset Management module for Consumable Assets in the Digii campus-management platform.

chunks.what_it_does: The functionality to delete a product is not supported once it has been created in the Asset Management module for Consumable Assets.
chunks.why_it_matters: Users cannot remove product records from the system, which may lead to outdated or incorrect data persistence and clutter in the product list.

chunks.what_it_does: Product details such as name, code, or unit of measurement cannot be modified after creation in the Asset Management module for Consumable Assets.
chunks.why_it_matters: Users cannot correct or update product information once entered, potentially leading to inaccurate inventory data, incorrect reporting, and operational inefficiencies.

chunks.what_it_does: Purchase information like vendor, invoice, or receipt details cannot be edited once saved in the Asset Management module for Consumable Assets.
chunks.why_it_matters: Errors in purchase records cannot be corrected directly, requiring manual workarounds or leading to inaccurate financial tracking and inventory discrepancies.

chunks.what_it_does: Allotment records cannot be modified after allotment. Asset Administrators will have to return all the quantity allotted and make a new allotment record.
chunks.why_it_matters: Correcting allotment errors requires a multi-step process of returning and re-allotting, which is inefficient, time-consuming, and prone to further errors or data inconsistencies.
how_to_use: Return all the quantity previously allotted.
Create a new allotment record with the correct details.
examples: If an administrator accidentally allots 10 pens instead of 5, they must first return all 10 pens and then create a new allotment for 5 pens.
To change the recipient of an allotted item, the original allotment must be returned, and a new one created for the correct recipient.

chunks.what_it_does: The platform does not currently send automated alerts or email notifications when consumable stock falls below the reorder threshold or when products near their expiry date.
chunks.why_it_matters: Without automated alerts, users must manually monitor stock levels and expiry dates, increasing the risk of stockouts, expired inventory, waste, and inefficient inventory management.

chunks.what_it_does: Administrators cannot upload multiple purchase details at once using an Excel file. Each batch must be added individually.
chunks.why_it_matters: Manually adding each purchase record is time-consuming and inefficient, especially for large volumes of purchases, increasing administrative workload and potential for data entry errors.
how_to_use: Add each batch of purchase details individually through the user interface.
examples: If an administrator has 50 purchase records to enter, they must input each one separately instead of using a single Excel upload.
There is no option to import a CSV or Excel file containing multiple purchase entries.
